body_markdown:
**Oak Ridge, TN, September 8, 2026** —[Daxor Corporation](https://url.avanan.click/v2/___https://www.daxor.com/___.YXAzOmRheG9yOmE6ZzpkY2FjN2I2ZWZlNjRmZDc5NjIwMzU2YjFhOTAxMzMxOTo2OjBhNzk6OGY3ODQ3ZjRhZmU2YmQ2OTNmNWZiM2JjZjBiMTkwNjYxMzlmY2VjZDM1ZTZhM2ZiM2E4Njg4YzlkYjg5MDdlNjpwOlQ6Tg) (Nasdaq: DXR), the global leader in blood volume measurement technology, announces today that CEO and President Michael Feldschuh will participate in Lake Street’s Tenth Annual Best Ideas Growth (BIG10) Conference in New York City, New York on Thursday, September 10th, 2026.


Management will host one-on-one and small group meetings with investors. For more information about the event or questions about registration, interested parties should reach out to their contacts at Lake Street.


Interested investors may also contact Bret Shapiro at CORE IR either by calling 1-516-222-2560 or emailingbrets@coreir.com .


Sign up to receive news on Daxor’s innovative technology and investor announcements[HERE](https://url.avanan.click/v2/___https:/www.daxor.com/investors/___.YXAzOmRheG9yOmE6ZzphZDA2MWNiNWIzNDJlZDZiZTNjMmM5OTViMzgzMTc2OTo2OmY4Yjk6ZDg3NjJmNjQ2YjcwOTE1NDBjNmM0Y2JkN2JhZjYwZDc0ZDQwNjVmODQ2NDJlYjExYmE3ZDg3ZmVjZTFjOWYxZDpwOlQ6Tg) .


**About Daxor Corporation**


[Daxor Corporation](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/r01/___https://daxor.com/___.YXAzOmRheG9yOmM6ZzpmYjYwYjZhNjUxMTMwMjc2OWYyMDllZmFlZTEwY2RmYTo3OmUwOTk6ZDc1YzdmZmIxODE3YWJlMGMxYTUwNmM1OTgzMGY2N2ExZmY1MzAyMDZlYmM0NzkyMmU2MjNiYzJhZGFmZjNhMjpwOlQ6Tg) (Nasdaq: DXR) is tackling healthcare’s “multi-billion-dollar silent crisis”, the inability to precisely measure blood volume. This often results in suboptimal care, prolonged hospital stays, and increased readmissions for many high-cost medical conditions like heart failure and those requiring ICU care. With 50 years of experience and innovation, Daxor is proud to manufacture and distribute its patented, FDA-cleared Blood Volume Analysis (BVA) diagnostic which offers unmatched, real-time, precise data via its rapid, hand-held, lab-based system. This empowers clinicians to make individualized treatment decisions that significantly improve patient outcomes and deliver substantial efficiencies in value-based healthcare. Daxor is ISO certified and operates a U.S.-based, 20,000-square-foot state-of-the-art manufacturing facility, positioning the company for accelerated market expansion.
